test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series

120, 121, ?, 140, 76, 201
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The difference between two consecutive terms is a cube of an odd number.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14a94ab334fc4e3ce383973dd153976c30c90f9d1dc3acd0fa78719356b4b28d.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
